title: Australian Human Rights Commission Repeal (Duplication Removal) Bill 2018
short_title: Australian Human Rights Commission Repeal (Duplication Removal) Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would end federal funding for a human rights commission that advocates on behalf of people.
It expects state and territory governments to take over human rights advocacy and responsibility.
The bill would start the day after it receives royal assent.
changes: Removes Commonwealth involvement in a publicly funded commission for human rights advocacy.
Preserves the right of aggrieved people to take action under state or territory anti-discrimination regimes.
summary.affected: People who would have used the federal commission for human rights advocacy, and state and territory governments that would take up that role.
